Question: Using NHANES data from 1999-2008, we will perform a prevalence analysis of diabetes, defined by diagnosis or glycohemoglobin level. Use weighted prevalence if available. We will group by a vision category  'vision group', defined using the better vision eye among right and left eye: "Group 1" No VI (Reference Group): visual acuity, presenting is 20/40 or better. "Group 2" Correctable VI (CVI): visual acuity, presenting is worse than 20/40, but visual acuity with refraction is 20/40 or better. "Group 3" Nonrefractive VI (NVI): visual acuity, presenting  is worse than 20/40, and visual  acuity with refraction  is still worse than 20/40. Include people whose age (years) is equal or more than 20, and exclude participants with missing vision values, age, who are missing both diabetes diagnosis or glycohemoglobin level.
Structured Question:
Analysis Type: weighted prevalence

Dataset: NHANES

Period of Interest: 1999-2008

Inclusion Criteria:
- age (years) >= 20

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing visual acuity, presenting (right eye) OR missing visual acuity, presenting (left eye) OR missing visual acuity with refraction (right eye) OR missing visual acuity with refraction (left eye)
- missing age (years)
- missing diabetes diagnosis AND missing glycohemoglobin level

Grouping Variables:
- vision group categorized as:
  - "Group 1" No VI:
    If (visual acuity, presenting (right eye) is 20/40 or better) OR (visual acuity, presenting (left eye) is 20/40 or better)

  - "Group 3" Nonrefractive VI (NVI):
    If NOT ((visual acuity, presenting (right eye) is 20/40 or better) OR (visual acuity, presenting (left eye) is 20/40 or better))
    AND NOT ((visual acuity with refraction (right eye) is 20/40 or better) OR (visual acuity with refraction (left eye) is 20/40 or better))

Outcome:
- diabetes = 1 if (diagnosis indicates diabetes OR glycohemoglobin level meets threshold); 0 otherwise
  (Note: The specific threshold for glycohemoglobin level to define diabetes is not provided.)

    t1."right_visual_acuity_presenting",
    t2."left_visual_acuity_presenting",
    t3."right_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction",
    t4."left_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction",
    t5."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes",
    t6."glycohemoglobin"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening t0 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t0.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_right_visual_acuity_presenting t1 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t1.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_left_visual_acuity_presenting t2 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t2.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_right_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction t3 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t3.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_left_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction t4 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t4.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes t5 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t5.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_glycohemoglobin t6 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t6.respondent_sequence_number;

-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes all patients age (years) is equal or more than 20
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "age_in_years_at_screening" >= 20;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude participants with any missing visual acuity data
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE NOT (
    f."right_visual_acuity_presenting" IS NULL OR
    f."left_visual_acuity_presenting" IS NULL OR
    f."right_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction" IS NULL OR
    f."left_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction" IS NULL
);

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing age (years)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants missing both diabetes diagnosis or glycohemoglobin level
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE NOT (
    f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" IS NULL AND
    f."glycohemoglobin" IS NULL
);

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Vision Group
-- Determine visual acuity status for each eye and type
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_visual_acuity_status AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  (f."right_visual_acuity_presenting" IN ('20/20', '20/25', '20/30', '20/40')) AS "va_presenting_right_better_or_equal_20_40",
  (f."left_visual_acuity_presenting" IN ('20/20', '20/25', '20/30', '20/40')) AS "va_presenting_left_better_or_equal_20_40",
  (f."right_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction" IN ('20/20', '20/25', '20/30', '20/40')) AS "va_refraction_right_better_or_equal_20_40",
  (f."left_visual_acuity_w_obj_refraction" IN ('20/20', '20/25', '20/30', '20/40')) AS "va_refraction_left_better_or_equal_20_40"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Assign vision group based on derived conditions
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_vision_group AS
SELECT
  "respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN ("va_presenting_right_better_or_equal_20_40" OR "va_presenting_left_better_or_equal_20_40") THEN 'Group 1 No VI'
    WHEN NOT ("va_presenting_right_better_or_equal_20_40" OR "va_presenting_left_better_or_equal_20_40")
         AND ("va_refraction_right_better_or_equal_20_40" OR "va_refraction_left_better_or_equal_20_40") THEN 'Group 2 Correctable VI (CVI)'
    WHEN NOT ("va_presenting_right_better_or_equal_20_40" OR "va_presenting_left_better_or_equal_20_40")
         AND NOT ("va_refraction_right_better_or_equal_20_40" OR "va_refraction_left_better_or_equal_20_40") THEN 'Group 3 Nonrefractive VI (NVI)'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "vision_group"
FROM temp_visual_acuity_status;

-- 4.2 Diabetes
-- Determine diabetes status based on diagnosis or glycohemoglobin level
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes' OR f."glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS "diabetes"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  vg."vision_group",
  d."diabetes"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_vision_group vg ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = vg."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_diabetes d ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = d."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 6: Final Output ==========
SELECT * FROM temp_final_table;

-- STEP: Create merged final table with design variables + in_analysis flag
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_final_with_weights;

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_with_weights AS
SELECT 
    wd."respondent_sequence_number",
    wd."masked_variance_pseudo_psu",
    wd."masked_variance_pseudo_stratum",
    wd."survey_weight",
    CASE WHEN ft."respondent_sequence_number" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "in_analysis",
    ft."vision_group",
    ft."diabetes"
FROM weight_design wd
LEFT JOIN temp_final_table ft
  ON wd."respondent_sequence_number" = ft."respondent_sequence_number";
